name: sotf-forest-night
about: Sons of the Forest's forest by moonlight: ten first-person gameplay frames from Endnight's Trailer 2 on the Steam store (frames t2-03 to t2-07 and t2-10 to t2-14 of a still every two seconds), without campfires, torches or the letterboxed cinematic shots. The lush forest's target by night (D310).
